## About
Hillsborough Transmission & Auto Service is a family owned and operated shop in Hillsborough Township. Our ASE certified technicians work on automatic and standard transmissions, drive lines, differentials, transfer cases and CV axles, along with general auto repair.
We use computerized diagnostics to find out what is really wrong before we start the work. One longtime customer described us as fair, honest, professional and reasonably priced, and that is the kind of shop we want to be for our neighbors.
Whether it is an engine overhaul or a tire rotation, call and talk to Gary about what your car needs.

## Services
- Transmission repair and maintenance: Repair and upkeep for your transmission, so it keeps shifting the way it should.
- Drive line and differential work: Help with drive lines and differentials when something in the drivetrain goes wrong.
- Computerized diagnostics: Accurate answers before the wrenches come out.
- Auto repair: Beyond transmissions, we take care of your everyday auto repair needs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on manual transmissions too?
A: Yes. Automatic and standard transmissions are both our specialty.

Q: Do you only do transmissions?
A: No. We also handle general auto repair, from engine overhauls to tire rotations.

Q: When are you open?
A: Weekdays, and we are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Give us a call to confirm hours before you stop by.
